name: kristos80/hook
description: A lightweight, WordPress-style hooks system for PHP. Add actions and filters with priority support to create extensible, event-driven applications.

scripts-descriptions.test-coverage: Run the test suite with line coverage; fails below 100%. Needs a coverage driver (Xdebug or PCOV) enabled.
scripts-descriptions.test-mutate: Run mutation testing; fails below a 100% score. Needs a coverage driver enabled.
scripts-descriptions.analyse: Run PHPStan at level max against src/.
scripts-descriptions.check: Run every quality gate: PHPStan, coverage and mutation testing. Needs a coverage driver enabled.
scripts-descriptions.check-local: Same as check, using the `herd coverage` variants (Laravel Herd on macOS only).
scripts-descriptions.test-coverage-local: Same as test-coverage, wrapped in `herd coverage` (Laravel Herd on macOS only).
scripts-descriptions.test-mutate-local: Same as test-mutate, wrapped in `herd coverage` (Laravel Herd on macOS only).
